name: funnel
description: Growth funnel (identified, started registration, registered, confirmed, attended) plus walk-ins, no-shows and the biggest leak.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: targetsVsActuals
description: Goals in force vs actuals: identified, registered, verified visitors (projected before the event), spend vs budget.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: campaignTable
description: Per-campaign KPIs: spend, identified, registered, confirmed, attended, show-up %, INR per registration / confirmed / actual attendee, share of spend vs attendees, engaged share, plan budget and status.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: flags
description: Scale / watch / stop flag for each campaign with a plain-English reason and the numbers behind it.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: projection
description: Before the event: projected verified visitors (low/mid/high) from confirmed registrants and Settings assumptions. After: the actual and the error of the day-before projection.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: pace
description: Daily cumulative registrations vs a linear target line, average daily rate over the last 7 days and the rate required to reach the goal.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: momentum
description: What is driving change: registrations and spend per campaign in the last N days vs the N days before, plus recent data edits.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: showupDrivers
description: After the event: show-up rate by engagement type and by registration lead time (associations, not causes).

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: query
description: Slice and count the data for questions the other tools do not cover. For the busiest or biggest group (an hour, a day, a campaign), group by that field and read largestGroup, which covers every group whatever the order or limit. To count people by how many event days they came, use dataset people with the field days_attended. Dataset people: fields person_id (stable id), person_type (external | internal | staff | test), first_touch_source (first source seen), first_campaign_id (first-touch campaign), campaign_id (acquisition campaign from the registration), registered (true/false), registered_day (YYYY-MM-DD), weeks_before_event (whole weeks between registration and event start), status (interested | confirmed | cancelled | waitlisted (at as-of, or at event start once it began)), confirmed (true/false), engaged (submitted an event question), interaction_types (list; use op 'contains'), attended (true/false), walk_in (attended without a registration), days_attended (number of event days attended), attended_days (list of YYYY-MM-DD; use op 'contains'), first_attended_day (YYYY-MM-DD); measures people, registered, confirmed, engaged, attended, walk_ins, show_up_pct. Dataset scans: fields person_id (stable id), person_type (external | internal | staff | test), day (YYYY-MM-DD (IST)), hour (0-23 (IST)), result (admitted | denied | pending), verification (verified | unverified), source (scanner | manual), campaign_id (acquisition campaign of the person), counts_as_attendance (admitted AND verified AND external AND scanned while the event was on); measures scans, distinct_people. Dataset daily_marketing: fields campaign_id (campaign), day (YYYY-MM-DD), week (Monday of the week), platform (platform); measures spend, impressions, clicks, sessions, registration_starts, ctr_pct.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: actionList
description: Who to act on: confirmed people who asked no question, interested but not confirmed, waitlisted, and people who failed a gate scan and were never admitted. Gives counts, campaign split and a few examples. Leave cohort out for all group sizes.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: whatIf
description: Simulate budget moves between campaigns, a cut to the whole budget, and/or a different show-up rate among confirmed registrants. Returns a cautious-to-optimistic range with its assumptions. Before the event only the unspent budget can change, a percentage is of the budget, and the result is a change with no new total. Always use this for 'what if' questions instead of calculating yourself.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: searchPeople
description: Search people by name or person_id; returns matches with type, campaign, latest status, attended and engaged.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: person
description: One person's profile, registrations, attendance and full timeline. Look up by person_id (names repeat).

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: tasks
description: Tasks with owner, team, due date, status and overdue flag; optional filters.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: tickets
description: Requests between the festival's own teams (publicity, sponsorship, events): who asked whom for what, status, needed-by date, history and linked tasks. Pass ticketId, or filter to three tickets or fewer, to read the details. You cannot create or change tickets.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: dataHealth
description: Data quality: duplicate IDs per table, conflicting duplicates, denied/pending/unverified scans, non-external admissions, negative spend rows, unattributed visitors.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: eventInfo
description: Event dates, history window and every target version.

name: betStatus
description: The five growth bets (B1 to B5) and the whole plan (PLAN): each bet's KPIs (K01 to K22) with verdict (Scale, Change, Stop, Too early, Not enough data, Not applicable, Tracking), value, check date, threshold action and bet spend vs budget. Pass betId for one bet in detail, or kpiId for one KPI with its numbers, threshold and breakdown (for example per college). Use for any question about bets, KPIs, verdicts or checkpoints.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: bookings
description: The fest program by venue and session: seats offered, seats booked, waitlist, exchange offers claimed / expired / open, door attendance and people turned away, venue fill by day, sold-out and overbooked sessions. Filter by venueId, eventId, day (YYYY-MM-DD) or bookableOnly.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: championship
description: College Championship standings (points, rank, attendees, tier), the Contingent Trophy, results recorded and point mismatches. Pass collegeId for one college with its contingents and tiers reached; top for how many rows (default 10).

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: payments
description: Money from passes: payments by kind (pre-booking, lock-in, single, gate, cashback, wallet credit, exam refunds), passes by state (pre-booked, locked in, cancelled or released, valid, hostel), exam-clash insurance claims and approved refunds, and the pre-book, lock-in, claims and givebacks KPIs.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

name: sponsor
description: Sponsor acquisition records, which are separate from the attendee data: brands, contacts, outreach, qualification, partnership opportunities and links to attendee campaigns. Reports: overview (goals, brand counts, opportunity stages, reported value); campaigns (results per sponsor campaign); opportunities (latest state of each; filter by stage or search); brands (search, or filter by qualification); brand (one brand's full history; search = brand ID or exact name); activations (sponsor links to attendee campaigns). Reported sponsorship value is not proof of payment.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; default is the selected date.

search.description: Text to find; for report 'brand', the brand ID or exact name.

name: proposeTask
description: Show the user a draft of ONE new task to review, edit and confirm. Nothing is saved until they confirm.

description.description: What to do and how success will be checked.

campaignId.description: Campaign id this is about, if any.

ticketId.description: Id of the ticket this task answers, if any, copied from the tickets tool.

ownerId.description: owner_id from the team list, if clear.

reason.description: Why, in one or two sentences.

evidence.description: The figures this rests on, copied from the summary or tool results.

name: openInApp
description: Show a 'Take me there' button for a change you cannot make yourself. Targets: campaign = a campaign: edit status or budget (id = campaign id); task = tasks: edit status, owner, due date or delete (id = task id); ticket = tickets between teams: raise, comment, accept, decline or edit (id = ticket id); daily_marketing = daily marketing rows: spend and traffic (id = campaign id); targets = goal versions; data_quality = the data-quality list: records left out, read differently or worth a check; checkins = gate scan rows (id = person id); settings = assumptions and decision thresholds; person = one person's timeline (id = person id); actions = full lists of people to act on; whatif = the what-if simulator screen; venue = a venue on the campus map: its sessions and seats (id = venue id); event = a session on the campus map (id = program event id); bet = the bet tracker: KPIs, verdicts and thresholds (id = bet id B1 to B5, or PLAN); event_rules = the Event List: an event's rules, sessions and seats (id = event id such as group-dance); college = the College Championship board (id = college id).
